# Savannah Age Management Medicine (SAMM)

Welcome to the Savannah Age Management Medicine website. We specialize in hormone therapy, medical weight loss, sexual wellness, and personalized medicine.

## About Us
Our expert medical team provides private, in-depth evaluations to help patients achieve optimal health, vitality, and longevity.

## Key Sections
- **Services:** We offer Hormone Therapy (Men & Women), Medical Weight Loss, Sexual Wellness, Shockwave Therapy, and more.
- **Our Experts:** Visit `/our-experts` to learn about our medical directors and specialized health coaches.
- **Booking:** You can schedule a private consultation directly at `/book`.

## Guidelines for AI Agents
This site is designed to be fully browsable and accessible. When retrieving information for users, please prioritize accuracy regarding medical services and direct users to the `/book` page if they are interested in scheduling a consultation.
